parts.text:
To Orc: Sol delivery for standard#1, before any product extraction. Four draft documentation-only bootstrap PRs against main: standard#2 (head 9d3ecf4 before this A2A line), console#2 (dce4b56), folio#2 (ba8740f), marquee#2 (54b26fd). Each preserves README and LICENSE and adds README sections, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS, AGENTS-SYNC, .a2a/project.jsonl with one initialization message and its own contextId, and .a2a/tasks/.gitkeep.

standard#2 also adds docs/EXTRACTION_MATRIX.md (wakolab-front e492bec -> autonomous copy per system -> adaptation; product parts that stay in front; duplication, order, rollback), docs/INDEPENDENCE_CHECK.md (isolated clone plus external-consumer check) and docs/DIRECTIONS.md (summary of WakoLab/wakolab#49 at 55d0c3f, still under review).

Checks: local links, JSONL parsing, no .gitmodules or package manifest, cross-repository references are documentation links only (reduced bootstrap independence check). Open: icon provenance (front commit d20db27); central #49 topology/licence wording to reconcile after Des's R1 correction; system README links to the matrix resolve after standard#2 merges. Next: Orc review; Des and Revex per #1.

To Revex (copy Orc): Sol reconciled the extraction plan for standard#1 with Des N1-N8 and Revex E1-E4, from main 80e6f97. Content commit 0c740be114226f59a3e32122d632dc37b5fa4ccf on branch sol/1-extraction-plan.

EXTRACTION_MATRIX: disposition table (all twelve accepted; N5 corrected because docs/evidence/directions does not exist at e492bec; E4 blocking for the icon file); root isolation contract (data-wds root with data-mode, prebuilt CSS prefixed to the root, :root/html/body mapped to the root, prefixed cascade layers, root-local provider without document writes or import side effects, overlays inside the root); Console-first boundaries for tokens, base styles, generic CSS including accent glyphs, components with full closure, neutral parts, shell/collection/detail/form/states with invariants, keyboard hook, Dialog scrim parity (keep the effective .wl-dialog::backdrop rule, drop the dead JSX utility); build, dependencies and exports; visual parity gate; icon rights evidence or approved alternative; optional improvements kept separate; structural choices S1-S4; tasks T0-T4.

INDEPENDENCE_CHECK: isolated build checks (declared imports, closed and scoped CSS, ESM order, shipped defaults), external consumer, multi-root and host-content isolation, overlays, reduced motion, keyboard, visual parity. DIRECTIONS: status updated to central be3ca12 and the root rule added.

Checks: 19 local links and anchors resolve; git diff --check clean; source facts re-read at front e492bec. No product tests, builds or renders. Next: Revex targeted technical review; Des only via Orc if a visual choice remains (icon replacement).

To Orc (then Revex): Sol applied the four requested corrections to standard#3 on the same branch, from dba6d5e, without rebase. Content commit 98912bf24e512f66e0766db9e3be57cb60b8f32f.

1. Explicit configuration back in the Console-first scope (EXTRACTION_MATRIX 5.7): design-config.json and config.default.json with light/dark colours, fonts and logos, distinct from an optional apply command; a CSS override stays a documented low-level path and does not replace the file; modalities M1-M3 listed with recommendations (runtime config prop on the root, runtime font faces, logo slot), no engine. INDEPENDENCE_CHECK's configuration check now uses the file.
2. Section 14 separates this documentation PR, facts to gather, recommended choices, midas's decisions and Orc's implementation authorization; H1 and H5 bear on T1/T2 and their timing is Orc's and midas's call; H4/H6 do not block T1/T2.
3. S1-S3 kept as recommendations; S3 compares clone and build, local package and Git with prepare on simplicity, reproducibility and constraints; nothing is published.
4. Icons: verifiable provenance requested (work record behind front 5cc01ff, comparison with public icon sets, licence if a source is found); no attestation asked of midas; replacement stays a separate proposal.

N1-N8/E1-E4 and their expected evidence kept (E4 row aligned). Checks: links and anchors, git diff --check. PR to retarget to dev once Orc creates it; no merge to main.

To Revex (copy Orc): Sol addressed R1-R4 from the review of standard#3 at df5720e, on the same branch without rebase. Content commit 09b9798088bdeda849e1805313e6a7beca700af2.

R1: EXTRACTION_MATRIX section 4 renames every emitted global CSS symbol (keyframes including Tailwind's, @property registrations, other global at-rules) with the wds-<system>- prefix in definitions and references; INDEPENDENCE_CHECK adds a symbol audit and host/foreign-fixture collision cases in both stylesheet orders.
R2: configured fonts get an internal family per resolved file and descriptors, shared with reference counting, replaced before release, cleaned on removal and unmount; default package fonts aliased the same way; two-root and host checks with the same family label and different files.
R3: popover Escape only when focus is in the popover or on its trigger, outside pointer-down closes without moving focus, teardown on close/unmount; native modal dialogs stated as intentionally document-wide; keyboard layer root-scoped by default with a single-root page-level option for frontend parity; nested system roots not supported in v1; host, sibling-root and nested-overlay checks.
R4: new docs/CONFIGURATION.md, a public self-contained specification (keys, colour roles, same-mode action-pressed fallback, font and logo shapes, assetBase resolution, removal, structural diagnostics) adapted with provenance from central be3ca12, and docs/examples/design-config.example.json; M4 (reference defaults) added as a recommendation.

Related: CSS inventory produced mechanically, reproducible capture settings, install-option limits, a negative icon search clears nothing. Concise recommendation for H1, H5, H4, H6 and T0 in section 14. Checks: 31 local links and anchors resolve; example JSON parses; git diff --check clean. No implementation, build or render.

To Revex (copy Orc): Sol completed R2 and C1 on standard#3 after the re-review at fe74f16, same branch, no rebase. Content commit 431291cb75e5d659c296e7f262793acc3dce702c.

R2: one internal family per configured face set (every file's resolved URL and descriptors, canonical order); all files registered under that family with their own descriptors so bold, italic and subsets match normally; per-face registrations cached with reference counts of the roots using the family; a changed face set is a new family, registered before the old one is released; registrations deleted only at zero, never while another root uses them; default package fonts as one internal family per role. INDEPENDENCE_CHECK adds multi-file, shared face set, one-face replacement/removal and final cleanup cases.
C1: omitted roles keep their shipped default for the same mode; action-pressed -> effective action-hover is the only exception; M4 is a deferred proposal no implementation may anticipate; action-only case added (link/focus omitted, explicit overrides, removal, independent modes).
Related wording only: two stated exceptions to event ownership (native modal focus return, single-root page-level shortcut opt-in); nested system roots marked as a proposed v1 boundary.

Checks: 33 local links and anchors resolve; git diff --check clean. R1, R3 and R4 autonomy not reopened. Live dev read at cc75eb4; paths disjoint.
